progress.name: Hegemony Warrant

stages.title: Police patrols
stages.text: The Hegemony has issued a warrant in your name. Its police patrols are looking for you.

stages.title: Bounty hunters
stages.text: The bounty on your name is high enough for mercenaries to come looking.

stages.title: Hunted
stages.text: The Hegemony has sent a task force after you. It will not stop until your name is cleared.

factors.desc: John Starsector is still out there, using your name

progress.notes:
How the quest drives it (S10–S16):
- It starts when $global.toc_warrant_on is true (Act 2, S11), or at the first "Progress" action (an Action node › Progress points).
- Act 1 (S10) sets where it starts: Progress points per way out, e.g. pay 0, bluff 100, flee 200, fight 300 (fight also sets $global.toc_fought_hegemony = true).
- Monthly: +50 while open; +40 after fighting the Hegemony ($global.toc_fought_hegemony); +30 while John is free ($global.toc_john_free). All stop when $global.toc_name_cleared is true.
- One-time: chasing John at the gala +250; saving the Wheel -200; each Evidence handed to the tax collector -100 (S16).
- Stages: 300 police patrols (Warrant Patrol), 600 bounty hunters, 1000 hunted (Hegemony Manhunt); then back to 700, so the manhunt returns while the warrant stays open.
